description: Use when you have a handle from watch_free and you want what changed on that free watch. Free (pass handle from watch_free). Measured changes on a watch_free host (price, payTo, valid 402, listing, tools hash) with receipt links.

handle.description: Free watch handle string (brs_...) from watch_free. Same value as token.

since.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC time, e.g. 2026-11-25T00:00:00Z. Omit to use watch start.

token.description: Same value as handle (brs_...). Used only when handle is omitted.

name: what_changed
title: What changed (free watch)
